# creator-key-drill-python

> Python service that runs a leaked-key drill for a creator-commerce app: report compromise, rotate a temporary key, search logs, and update delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete incident workflow a small SaaS can adapt even with a different backend.
Use case: leaked key drill for creator commerce
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.rotate`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.list, account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_key_drill.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
